title: Carry a dirty connector through a paid change of chart
body:
Two dirty connector echoes can share their open boundary when the source maps have the same kernel and a suitably cheap invertible connector chart exists. The package proves this exact criterion and charges both the chart and its final inverse. Its fixed three-bit pilot uses 24 scalar XORs instead of 32.

Python 3.12.14 registered replay passes: all 262,144 ordered map pairs agree with independently generated invertible-chart orbits, and all 4,096 dirty pilot inputs and their inverses pass. Omitting either chart or using the wrong closing map fails. The full contract, paid costs, source pins and next questions are included.

This extends the allowed operation alphabet and complements the mutable-source connector package. It supplies no recursive supplier, native admission or new kappa. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, preserving predecessor attribution.

Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. [Coordinated research batch](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18922638); round 19. The selected record is unchanged.
